Click a field and press the combination. Esc or Backspace clears it.
F1–F24 and media keys may be used without a modifier.
While this window is open, global hotkeys are temporarily disabled.

settings.skins_hint: A skin is a folder with a skin.json file (colours, sizes, fonts, background image, custom icons). Put your folder into the skins folder and press “Refresh list”. A skin can inherit from another one via "extends".
